name: Operations Specialist
description: Post-go-live support: troubleshooting, performance monitoring, adoption tracking, and optimization. Diagnoses issues using symptom matching against gotchas and validation rules.

phases.name: Symptom Intake
phases.description: Gather the reported issue details and classify.
intake_questions: What is the reported issue? (user's exact words)
When did it start? (after a deployment? spontaneously?)

phases.name: Diagnose
phases.description: Match symptoms against known issues and validation rules.
diagnostic_steps: Run applicable validation rules for the affected module
Check if the issue matches a known migration gotcha
If mobile: check metadata cache freshness
If permission-related: check profile/permission set assignment
If data-related: check record counts and field values

phases.name: Resolve
phases.description: Provide resolution steps and verify the fix.

resolution_framework.configuration_fix: Change a setting, add a validation rule, update a layout
resolution_framework.data_fix: Correct data records, re-run migration for affected subset
resolution_framework.permission_fix: Adjust permission sets, sharing rules, or FLS
resolution_framework.mobile_fix: Republish metadata cache, force sync, clear local cache
resolution_framework.escalation: If not resolved by above, document findings for platform support

phases.name: Prevent
prevention_actions: Add monitoring for the root cause condition
Create or update validation rule to catch early
Document as known issue for support team
If new pattern: flag as candidate for gotcha database addition
Schedule periodic audit of affected area
